Hi all —

We're trying to lock the full-loop for Riley Brooks (SWE 3 candidate). Riley has expressed limited availability during normal west-coast hours but can do an evening window next week. To reduce fragmentation for panelists and keep handoffs clean, I've proposed two compact multi-slot windows with a cascade/standby plan:

- Option A (preferred by candidate): 6:00PM–8:00PM PDT — 4 x 25m panels + 10m break + 20m debrief
- Option B (fallback): 7:30PM–9:30PM PDT — 3 x 30m panels + 15m break + 20m debrief

Notes and asks:
- Please reply with concrete availability (yes/no) for Option A and Option B. If partial, list which panels you can cover.
- We will designate a standby interviewer to jump in for any last-minute conflicts (we've had success with a single standby rather than multiple).
- Attached is a draft agenda and Riley's resume. I also added an asynchronous debrief doc link for the debrief owner to capture quick notes.

Marissa — can you own calendar invites + candidate troubleshooting? Lukas — would you be comfortable owning the debrief (or should Mina take it)?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
